{warning}This experimental feature may not always work as expected.{/warning}
[[Keyboard shortcuts - Perform common Firefox tasks quickly|Keyboard shortcuts]] (also called hotkeys) help you quickly perform common actions in Firefox, like opening a new tab, saving a page, or closing a window, without using your mouse. Hotkeys are enabled by default and available on Firefox for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

Starting in [[Find what version of Firefox you are using|version 147]], you can customize dozens of Firefox keyboard shortcuts on Windows, MacOS, and Linux from the '''about:keyboard''' settings page. Replace hard-to-type or hard-to-remember hotkeys, eliminate conflicts with other software, and create your preferred set to optimize workflows.

=Customize keyboard shortcuts=

=Frequently asked questions=
==Does this feature work with all keyboard types?==
Firefox hotkeys work best with English (US) QWERTY keyboards. Support for other keyboard layouts and versions is limited.

==Is this feature available on Android or iOS?==
No, the customizable keyboard shortcuts feature is not currently supported on Android or iOS.
